Commitment Statement of Abadis Medical Technologies Co. to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs)

Abadis Medical Technologies Co., as a pioneering knowledge-based company and the leading manufacturer of disposable suction bags in Iran, is committed to aligning its operations with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs).
We believe that industrial development holds true value only when it promotes public health, contributes to the conservation of natural resources, reduces environmental impacts, and encourages a culture of responsible consumption.

Key Objectives and Alignment with SDGs

  1. Good Health and Well-Being (SDG 3)
  • Enhancing patient and healthcare staff safety by eliminating direct contact with infectious fluids.
  • Improving hospital hygiene and reducing the risk of healthcare-associated infections.
  1. Clean Water and Sanitation (SDG 6)
  • Eliminating the traditional washing process of suction tanks, resulting in significant water savings.
  • This saving is scalable: each suction bag saves an average of 25 liters of water.
  • With thousands of bags used daily in hospitals, the total savings have continuously increased—by the end of 2023, more than 28 million liters of water were saved, and the company currently achieves an average annual saving of about 10 million liters.
  1. Affordable and Clean Energy (SDG 7)
  • By removing the need for washing, sterilizing, and drying reusable tanks, consumption of electricity, steam, and disinfectants has been drastically reduced.
  • This contributes to a smaller carbon footprint and decreased reliance on non-renewable energy in hospitals.
  1. Decent Work and Economic Growth (SDG 8)
  • Creating sustainable job opportunities in production, quality control, and export of knowledge-based medical products.
  • Expanding production capacity to nearly two million suction bags annually (as of 2023).
  • Strengthening local capabilities in medical device manufacturing and reducing dependency on imports.
  1. Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure (SDG 9)
  • Localizing suction bag production technology and developing domestic manufacturing infrastructure.
  • Expanding exports to regional markets, including Oman and Iraq, with plans to enter Central Asian markets.
  1. Responsible Consumption and Production (SDG 12)
  • Replacing high-consumption processes with safer and more efficient solutions.
  • Implementing the “No Paper Catalog” initiative, first launched at Iran Health 2022, where all printed materials were replaced with digital QR code catalogs.
  • Visitors supported the campaign by signing the “No-Paper Commitment Wall”, and since 2022, Abadis has completely discontinued printed catalogs.
  1. Climate Action (SDG 13)
  • Executing corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives such as the Green Zagros Tree-Planting Project to help restore damaged forest areas.
  • Targeting the annual planting of at least 1,000 trees in western Iran by 2027.

 

Date of Issue: March 2023

Actions Achieved by the End of 2023

  • Producing approximately 2 million suction bags per year for hospitals nationwide.
  • Preventing thousands of liters of infectious liquids from entering wastewater systems through safer product design.
  • Achieving a total water saving of 22 million liters by the end of 2023, with a continuous growth rate of 10 million liters per year.
  • Launching the Green Zagros tree-planting project.
  • Creating more than 50 specialized direct jobs in production, quality control, and R&D departments.
  • Engaging in research and business intelligence (BI) projects focused on sustainability and real-time impact measurement.
  • Collaborating with Virakom to analyze environmental data through BI sustainability dashboards.

Future Commitments (From 2024 Onward)

Abadis is committed to continuing its path of sustainable innovation through:

  • Expanding green exports to regional markets,
  • Establishing training infrastructure for hospitals on efficient resource use,
  • Extending the Green Zagros project to additional provinces,
  • And publishing the Abadis Annual Sustainability Report starting in 2024, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement.

Corporate Social Responsibility at Abadis Medical Co

As the first and largest manufacturer of disposable suction liner bags in Iran, Abadis Medical Co., a knowledge-based company, has always strived to fulfill its social responsibilities alongside its commercial and industrial operations. We firmly believe that true success is only achieved through creating value for society, the environment, and future generations.

From the beginning of our operations, the management and shareholders of Abadis have placed great importance on addressing social and cultural challenges. Our activities in this area go far beyond supporting charities such as Mahak, Kahrizak, and the Autism Association of Iran — they also include building schools in underprivileged areas, supporting emerging knowledge-based startups, helping release prisoners, and distributing food supplies in disadvantaged communities.

We believe that social responsibility should not merely be a slogan; it must become a core organizational culture. In line with this, the Board of Directors at Abadis has defined these efforts as key objectives, alongside profitability, and has established clear performance indicators to achieve them.

One of our most notable initiatives has been organizing appreciation campaigns for healthcare workers. During the COVID-19 crisis, for example, we expressed our gratitude to nurses and medical staff through various support programs. These efforts reminded us that every step toward social responsibility brings growth and blessings to the organization. For this reason, we continue to hold annual online ceremonies to honor nurses across the country.

Abadis has also taken steps to protect the environment through projects such as planting thousands of oak trees in the Zagros region. This initiative reflects our deep commitment to preserving nature and safeguarding the future for coming generations.

On this page, we proudly present our social responsibility efforts and achievements — to show that Abadis is more than just a manufacturer of medical equipment. We are a partner to the community, a supporter of the environment, and a collaborator in building a better future for all.

Our goal is lasting impact — for people, for nature, for the world.

Abadis Medical Co.’s Environmental Efforts to Save the Zagros Region

Abadis Medical Co., committed to its social responsibilities, launched the “Save the Zagros” campaign in 2023. This initiative was designed to protect and restore the Zagros oak forests, a region that plays a vital role in Iran’s ecosystem and water resources.

As part of this campaign, over 400 oak trees were planted at Abadis customer healthcare centers on the National Tree Planting Day (March 6th). This act not only symbolizes our gratitude for our customers’ trust but also represents a practical step towards reducing environmental damage and revitalizing nature.

Our vision is to plant 4,000 oak trees in the region, aiming to make a meaningful impact in curbing the degradation of the Zagros and combating climate change through ongoing efforts.

Abadis invites everyone to join this journey. By choosing our products, you too contribute to this great cause.

Together, we can save the Zagros — for you, for nature, for the future.

Abadis Medical Co.’s Efforts During the COVID-19 Crisis

During the COVID-19 crisis, Abadis Medical Co., in line with its commitment to social responsibility, stood firmly alongside the nation’s healthcare professionals and medical centers. Despite the challenging circumstances, the company not only maintained its medical equipment installation services but also operated around the clock to manufacture essential products — playing a vital role in infection control and the fight against the virus.

In addition to producing disposable suction liner bags, Abadis quickly pivoted to design and produce protective face shields for healthcare workers. Simultaneously, our research and development team began planning the production of innovative medical solutions, several of which will be introduced in the near future.

Other key contributions included donating medical supplies to charities, sending face masks and sanitizers to underprivileged areas, and supporting efforts to protect public health nationwide.

With faith in the cooperation of the Iranian people and divine guidance, Abadis has worked — and continues to work — to help the country overcome this crisis and build a safer future for all.

With Abadis, for health. With Abadis, for you.

Nurses’ Day Celebrations

Since 2019, Abadis Medical Co. has proudly established the tradition of celebrating Nurses’ Day as a heartfelt tribute to the invaluable contributions of nurses across Iran. These annual events have been held under diverse themes and programs, offering moments of recognition and gratitude for the remarkable dedication of these healthcare heroes.

In the first celebration, Abadis organized a special prize draw with live participation of nurses, broadcast on Aparat and Instagram. In the following years, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the celebrations continued virtually, with themes such as:
“If you saved one life, you are a hero — and if you saved a hundred, you are a nurse.”

In 2022, due to national circumstances, the in-person event was postponed, and instead, a special tribute video was released to honor the nurses. Then in 2023, under the heartfelt theme:
“We missed your smile, we waited for it — and now we celebrate its return,”
the Nurses’ Day celebration returned with renewed energy and enthusiasm.

In 2024, the tradition continued with the meaningful theme:
“Nursing: Saving lives in silence,”
and Abadis once again honored the noble spirit and essential role of nurses.

Abadis is proud to continue this tradition for nurses, for hope, for the future.

Suction Tube

The Abadis Suction Tube is an essential component in medical suction systems, designed for the removal of blood, secretions, and fluids during surgical and therapeutic procedures. Its use enhances the surgeon’s visual clarity and, by enabling rapid fluid evacuation, helps prevent contamination and the spread of infection to surrounding tissues.

Uses of suction tube:

  • Maintaining wound cleanliness for precise visualization of the bleeding site and prevention of infection transfer

  • Draining and cleaning abscess cavities

  • Suitable for thoracic, abdominal, and internal cavity surgeries

  • Effective for evacuating damaged brain tissue or soft brain tumors

  • Assisting in compressing a bleeding vessel

  • Applicable in aesthetic procedures: liposuction, lipolaser, lipomatic

  • Suitable for dental clinics

  • Compatible with fingertip suction controllers, suction catheters, and other related devices

Features and Advantages:

  • Manufactured from medical-grade PVC with high safety standards

  • Sterile, suitable for operating rooms and specialized departments

  • Available in two models:

    • Transparent (for visual monitoring of fluid flow)

    • Ribbed (to prevent kinking and blockage)

  • Controlled flexibility to minimize trauma to sensitive tissues

  • Secure, leak-free connection to various suction devices

  • Compatible with hospital and clinical suction systems

  • Smooth inner surface to prevent clogging and ensure consistent fluid flow

Sizes, Color Coding, and Customization:

Abadis Suction Tubes are available in three standard sizes:

  • 25 – Blue

  • 30 – Gray

  • 35 – Black

Standard Length:

  • 2 meters

Customization Options:

  • Production in different lengths based on the requirements of medical facilities

  • Available in special sizes upon customer request

Product Packaging:

  • Packed in 25-piece die-cut bundles

  • Quantity per carton: 100 pieces

  • Carton dimensions: 58 × 42 × 41 cm

  • Durable packaging suitable for storage and transportation

Fingertip

The Fingertip suction interruption is a small yet highly functional component used in medical suction systems, enabling healthcare professionals to precisely control the level of suction. This device is placed between the suction tubing and other suction accessories such as Nelaton catheters and suction catheters, providing accurate and adjustable performance.

Features & Benefits:

  • Optimal suction control simply by placing or removing a finger from the control port

  • Ergonomic design for long-term use

  • Reduced risk of soft tissue damage during suctioning

  • Compatible with various types of suction tubes

  • Secure connection to suction tubing, preventing fluid leakage

  • Easy-to-use mechanism for quick and effective suction adjustment without turning the suction device on or off

  • Medical-grade construction, suitable for general surgery, dental procedures, and critical care

Material & Sizes:

The fingertip is made of medical-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and is available in two sizes—large and small—to fit different types of suction tubing.

It is widely used in general surgery, plastic surgery, neurosurgery, and dentistry, helping improve suction efficiency while reducing the risk of injury to delicate tissues.

Our Products

Disposable suction liner bag

Disposable suction liner bag:

Disposable suction liner bags are available in 3 sizes: one liter, two liters, and three liters, and the filter in disposable suction liner bags is available in 3 types:

1) Hydrophobic filter: to prevent the entry of dangerous microorganisms and bacteria into the suction source and the surrounding environment

2) Dual filter: In addition to the advantages of the hydrophobic filter, it prevents the reduction of pressure drop in the operations that use the electrocautery device.

3) Mechanical filter: does not have the advantages of a hydrophobic filter but has the lowest pressure drop among existing filters.

Disposable suction liner bags also contain super absorbent powder to prevent the overflow of suctioned liquids into the environment.

Wall-mounted suction​

Wall suction includes regulators, a fluid-blocking filter, a suction canister with fittings, and a wall bracket for mounting on the console.

 

Product Features:

  •  The main components of wall suction are made of metal and brass.

  • It has a hand display with BAR and mmHg parameters.
  • It has a REG / OFF push button to quickly turn the vacuum on or off during use.
  • Impact resistance and no breakage of the product during long operation
  • Has a volume to adjust the desired amount of vacuum and reach the maximum possible vacuum with only 1.5 revolutions
  • Supports all available connectors to connect wall suction to splint
  • Has a negative interval of 0 to 1 times
  • Has nickel-chrome plating to increase product life span against fluids and air
  • No aperture to extend the product life span
  • Easy to use 
  • Has a five-year warranty

Filter

Read More

Filter

Disposable suction liner bags have a filter to prevent the overflow of suction liquids. These filters are important to prevent the release of contaminated liquids, made of hydrophobic or hydrophobic materials that interrupt the suction operation when the liquid reaches the filter surface. And prevents damage to the suction device.

Usage:

  • Can be used in a variety of portable and hospital suction.
  • Used to prevent overflow of suctioned fluids.
  • Used to prevent the release of contaminated fluids.

 

Advantages:

  • Prevents the release of toxic gases in electrosurgery and electrocautery smoke.
  • Prevents the damage of the suction device and increases the life of the suction device.

 

Flow stopper filter life span:

The filter should be replaced when liquids penetrate the filter surface or the suction pressure drops, and it is best to replace the circuit breaker filter every month for proper operation.

Description

To install on a portable device, the type and model of the device should be considered. Most of the devices used in medical centers in Iran are MEDELA and SAIRAN, which enjoy a profile under the motor part of the devices. Abadis Med. has designed a type of portable bracket for installing suction canisters, which is installed on the profile of these types of devices. Here, the installation of this product is explained step by step.

Step 01

The portable bracket consists of two parts that are attached to each other by two M4 size screws.

Step 02

The profile of the portable device is placed between these two parts and the bracket is fixed on the profile of the portable device all through tightening the screws.

Step 03

In this step, connect the T-connector and the connection on the 2 and 3 liter canisters.

Step 04

In this step, we measure the distance from the output of the portable device to the T-connector in canisters 2 and 3 and the vacuum connector in canisters 1. Then we cut the silicone vacuum tubing size 7*13 and connect one side of the vacuum tubing to the outlet of the portable suction device and the other side to the T-connector in canisters 2 and 3 and the vacuum connector in canisters 1.

Step 05

To test the absence of leakage of the output vacuum, we use the portable suction device to measure the maximum curve pressure. To perform this test, we first close the vacuum path of the canister (the hole inside the canister and the vacuum connector). In this case, if the portable suction device is filled with the maximum vacuum pressure, there should be no leakage in the installed connections.

Step 01

First, put the wall bracket on the metal console in the right place. This action allows you to have enough room to change the bags while you mount the canister on the bracket.

Step 02

After finding the right place for the wall bracket, mark the holes inside the brackets with a marker. Use a 15mm drill bit to drill holes in the metal console, which is often made of aluminum. With this action, if the copper fluid pipes behind the console are passed from an inappropriate place, the possibility of perforation and leakage will be eliminated.

Step 03

After installing the bracket, if you plan to install a 2- and 3-liter canister, then mount the T-connector and the connection on the canister.

Step 04

Next, slide the canisters onto the bracket from the top.

Step 05

After installation, measure the distance from the vacuum outlet (usually from the regulator) to the suction canister. Now, cut the silicone vacuum tubing size 7*13 and connect it from one side to the vacuum outlet and the other side of the vacuum tubing to the T-connector (if installing a 2 and 3 liter canister) or connect it to the Abadis vacuum connection (if installing a 1 liter canister).

Step 01

First, determine the approximate location of the trolley base in the surgery room. Then, measure from the vacuum outlet to the base of the trolley and cut the 7×13 silicone vacuum tubing based on that.

Step 02

Install the two parts of the vacuum tubing, one to the vacuum outlet and the other to the regulator or valve inlet, on the trolley base.

Step 03

On the 2 and 3 liter canisters, connect the T-connector and the connection. Then, measure the distance from the regulator outlet to the T-connector in the 2 and 3 liter canisters and the vacuum connection in 1 liter canisters.

Step 04

Cut the silicone vacuum tubing size 7*13. Connect one side of the vacuum tubing to the outlet of the regulator or valve and the other side to the T-connector in the 2 and 3 liter canisters and the vacuum connection in 1 liter canisters.

Step 05

To test the absence of leakage in the vacuum, close the output of the vacuum regulator to measure the maximum amount of negative pressure. Then, by closing the canister vacuum path (the hole inside the canister and the vacuum connection), bring the pressure to the maximum level in the vacuum regulator. In this case, there should not be any leakage in the installed connections.

دستورات استفاده­ی فیکسر (نگهدارنده)  لوله­ تراشه (غیر استریل)

یک بار مصرف

فیکسر (نگهدارنده لوله تراشه) آبادیس چیست؟

برای محکم کردن لوله تراشه در یک موقعیت مناسب در دهان بیمار از فیکسر (نگهدارنده لوله تراشه) استفاده می شود که سبب بهبود آسایش بیمار می گردد.

ویژگی­ های محصول

۱- عملکرد ایمن

۲- استفاده آسان

۳- دارای بند قابل تنظیم

۴- ارتقای کنترل عفونت بیمارستانی

۵- جلوگیری از زخم شدن لب و دهان بیمار

۶- حذف هزینه های مربوط به گاز و مواد ضدعفونی کننده

۷- آسایش بیماران را به همراه می آورد

مشخصات محصول و لوله های تراشه ای که می توان از آنها استفاده کرد.

طراحی شده برای مطابقت با لوله­های تراشه، که قطر داخلی (I.D) آنها در محدوده­ی ۶/۰ تا ۹/۰ میلی متر و قطر خارجی (O.D) در محدوده­ی ۸/۷ میلی متر تا ۱۲/۷ میلی متر می­باشد. لطفا توجه نمایید که لوله­ های تراشه مطابق با محدوده­های فیکسر (نگهدارنده لوله تراشه) هستند

The antibacterial filter (Viral Filter) is placed between the silicone slang and the canister, preventing microorganisms, germs and bacteria from escaping to the suction device, so that the environment is not contaminated with dangerous microorganisms inside the suction fluid. This filter also has the ability to filter microorganisms up to 0.03 microns. This feature prevents the spread of dangerous infections in the intensive care unit or operating room and greatly reduces the patient’s risk of nosocomial infections. To prevent the transmission of infection, the filter should be replaced after the patient is discharged.

Usage:

Technical guide

Should the Abadis canisters be changed after each use ?

No, Abadis canisters do not need to be replaced after each use.

What material are the Abadis Suction Bags made of?

The disposable suction liner bag is made of polyethylene (PE) and the canisters are made of polycarbonate.

What is the function of Abadis suction bag flow stopper filter?

These filters are made of nanoparticles and polymer and composite materials and  Abadis med Company is introduced as the first manufacturer of these filters in Iran.

Are the flow-stoppers filters produced in Iran?

Abadis Medical canisters Company is the first manufacturer of these filters in Iran.

What is a Abadis solidifying agent?

Absorbent powder in Abadis suction bags causes jelly of liquid materials inside the bags, which makes it easy to carry and also in case of overflow or torn bag, causes better collection of liquids inside the bag.

How long should suction bags be replaced when they start to be used?

Suction bags can be replaced after full filling and be sure not to move the suction bags of different patients together to better control the infection.

In which case disposable suction bags are not covered by the warranty?

1) Don’t use a disposable suction bag that fits the size of the canister.

2) suction Bags shouldn’t be replaced at least once every 24 hours if used.

3) Use the suction bags more than once.

This product will be out of warranty if the Abadis disposable suction bag isn’t used properly in the above cases.

What is the correct way to wash Abadis suction canisters?

1) Use disinfectants and water in the ratio of 1 to 10 to wash the suction canisters.

2) Roll the suction canisters for 10 minutes in the solution mentioned above; Be careful not to put the canisters in solution for more than the mentioned time because it will damage the canisters.

3)after that place the canister on a  dry towel and allow the canisters to dry completely.

4)Abadis suction canisters can be washed in autoclave up to 120 ° C.

5)The canister must be replaced if there are any cracks or fractures.

How to wash the canisters is only acceptable as above, and if the washing is not done in this way, it will be out of warranty.

* Keep in mind that Abadis suction canisters only need to be washed if there is contamination.

flow stopper filter should be replaced when fluids penetrate the filter surface or the suction pressure drops, and it is best to replace the circuit breaker filter every month for proper operation.

About us

Abadis Med, a knowledge-based company, operates with an innovative approach in the medical equipment industry. As a pioneer in hospital infection control, we have taken significant steps toward improving hygiene and safety in healthcare facilities.

Our Mission: Abadis Med is committed to providing specialized solutions and products for hospital waste management and infection prevention. By focusing on advanced technologies and intelligent hospital waste management, we strive to protect both patient health and the environment.

Our Vision: Abadis aims to eliminate and control hospital-acquired infections related to waste collection, drive research and development of innovative products, and establish sustainable solutions to enhance public health and environmental safety.

Achievements & Capabilities: As Iran’s largest manufacturer of disposable suction bags, Abadis has equipped over 500 healthcare facilities across 28 provinces. Leveraging advanced software and hardware infrastructure alongside a highly skilled team, we are fully prepared to export our products to the Middle East, Central Asia, the Caucasus, North Africa, and Central America.

We Affect as much as a Fingertip,To You , To Nature ,To World
